title: Empirical Anchors and Physical Measurement Maps in Local Bioenergetics
statement: Local muscle bioenergetics can achieve physiological structural identifiability (rank 7/7) without ideal scalar channels only if an independent 31P-MRS spectroscopic free-energy channel (Delta_G_ATP) is provided to break the actomyosin efficiency collinearity, while anatomical MRI volumetry must be coupled with dynamic motor unit recruitment models to bound active muscle volume V_active.
notes: Formulated and confirmed in Research Cycle 8.

title: Biophysical Motor Unit Decomposition and Volume Conduction as Identifiability Preconditions for Active Muscle Energetics
statement: Single-channel surface EMG amplitude cannot identify active muscle volume a_eff * V_anat due to structural collinearity with subcutaneous fat thickness and motor unit depth distribution; practical identifiability of a_eff requires high-density multi-channel array motor unit decomposition coupled with tissue morphometry, without which local bioenergetic models retain a minimum 40-fold parameter uncertainty span.
notes: Formulated and confirmed in Research Cycle 9 via biophysical modeling and empirical HD-sEMG / 31P-MRS cross-validation.

title: Multi-Muscle Synergistic Coordination and Co-Adapted Tendon Architecture Feasibility
statement: In vivo skeletal muscle force enhancement of +20% achieves greater than +20% net functional joint torque only when accompanied by synergistic neural tuning of reciprocal antagonist inhibition, while preserving a patellar tendon safety factor SF >= 1.5 through proportional connective tissue co-adaptation.
